{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the valid values in customer_segment and channel
print("Unique values in customer_segment:")
print(sales['customer_segment'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in channel:")
print(sales['channel'].unique())

# Check the values of converted
print("\nValue counts of converted:")
print(sales['converted'].value_counts())"}
